title: Unit Event — Light Up the Fire — Episode3 Hitting A Wall

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD's explosive third event has roused expectations that the team might actually surpass RAD WEEKEND. That's when Taiga summons them for "an important conversation"...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Hey, that sounded like Taiga singing just now!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah, that booming voice...!
Wait, that's where he's singing?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: And what are Vivid BAD SQUAD, Tono and everyone doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
This feels like...
No, they're not really gonna...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Are they battling against Taiga?!
I mean, even with those numbers, they don't stand a chance!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
No, I think they can win!
I mean, they're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was just warming up. Looks like everyone here knows when something's up.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: H-How are we supposed to beat him...?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
(This is bad...
He only sang for a little bit, but we all feel overwhelmed.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What he said about Nagi, the neighborhood, everything... None of it makes sense. I still have no idea what he's thinking. Even so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We can't run from this battle...
If we do, there's no way we'll ever be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, how much more time do you need to come up with a plan...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We can't make this crowd wait forever, so I'm just gonna pick someone...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Let's start with... You guys, EVER.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Looks like he's not even gonna give us a second to breathe...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Honestly, I don't think so...
This is probably the most scared of a battle we've ever been...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
But Shinonome's right...
We can't run! We have to fight!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys!
Let's do this!!!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: W-We're going to give it everything we've got. Our determination's gotten us this far...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Well, you get points for spirit.
Anyway, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The rules are simple. The side that gets the crowd going the most wins. With this many people, we should get a clear victor.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, you guys start us off. Take as much time as you want.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
What...?!
You're gonna regret talking down to us!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Hey, EVER's up first!
Man, they're so much better than most of the other teams out there!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Show him what you've got!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This is nothing like what we saw when he battled against Tono that time...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(So much power...!
In a split second, he swept everyone up in a torrent.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm getting fed up with this.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
(You've gotta be kidding me...
He just crushed us like a bug...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Alright, that should be enough.
Next, you.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I-I'm not running either...!
I'm gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm not scared! I don't have time to be scared...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Haha. I like your bravery.
Anyway, enough talk. Show me what you've got.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Yikes...! Who is that guy?! He's horrible!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Isn't that Mita?
I thought he had more skill than that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is bad...!
Taiga has him so overwhelmed that he can't sing like he normally does...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Mita, relax...!
Go at your own pace!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Being good also means being strong mentally. Don't ever forget that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Your singing was so bad I couldn't help shutting you up.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Well, you left me no choice.
After all, we shouldn't make these people here have to suffer through more of that.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I suppose this means I'm next...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Wait, didn't he battle against Taiga before? I remember him losing pretty badly, so I guess this is...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, Arata.
Looks like you finally have a chance for a rematch with me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: To be honest, I was hoping to win against you on an actual stage.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I'm not letting this opportunity go. Not after learning the true reason RAD WEEKEND was so unnaturally intense.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
No fun, as usual. You've always got that cocky look on your face.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Not today. I still can't quite process the truth about Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Now that I know, I can't just go around half-heartedly saying that I'm going to surpass that night.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
But I will surpass it.
And now I say that knowing what it means.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
You said that it's not possible, Taiga.
However, I am not about to waver.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm carrying Soma's hopes and dreams. And I'm going to make them come true...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, I am prepared! And I am going to win!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He has even more power than during our last event! And he doesn't seem bothered by Taiga at all...!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Is that all you've got, Arata?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (I've been doing everything I can to get better after losing to him that time. And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
(It's still not enough...!
All my efforts have gone to waste...!)

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
This is so awesome...!
I've never heard anyone sing like this before!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Argh...
Why...? Why can't I get any closer...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Arata, do you truly believe what you said earlier?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Are you really carrying Soma's hopes and dreams for him?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
O-Of course I am!
I'm doing everything I can for him!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I also lost a dear friend and sister when Nagi passed away. So I sort of understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I could kick and scream all I wanted, but she was never coming back. I've felt that loss...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And you're a better performer than just about everyone around here. No, I'd be hard-pressed to find another person as talented as you anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But you're still singing with your eyes closed. You're not seeing this place, this audience.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, Arata, let me ask you this. Who are you really singing for?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're not trying to make Soma's dreams come true. You can't face the pain of having lost him, so you're just clinging to his dreams.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm chasing this dream for Soma...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
...
I've been down that path before.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
So, I'll ask you again.
Arata, aren't you just singing for your own sake?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I told you all to take a closer look at this city before, but that requires you taking a hard look at yourself first...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Actually, you first need to ask if you actually want to surpass that night without Soma.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why are you doing this, Uncle Taiga...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: First, you drop a bombshell on us that Aunt Nagi's gone, and then you start sucker punching us...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: From where I'm standing, your friends behind you certainly seem to.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we've gotta do this. We have to...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because this is a bridge we have to cross sooner or later if we really are going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I...want to know.
I want to see how far we are from surpassing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Huh? It's Vivid BAD SQUAD, but just three of them?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Are you three here to admit defeat...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As for An... She'll come. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I guess that's the best you guys have got...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: (Shinonome and Aoyagi don't sound like their usual selves. And Azusawa's voice...sounds weak.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(This is bad...
Not even they can...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't know what's going on anymore...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Aunt Nagi's gone... I'm never gonna see her again... And everyone I know has been hiding that from me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel sick... My head's spinning... I can't process any of this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And he expects me to sing?! In this state...?!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't want to just stand still...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (They're putting up the best fight they can...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Against Uncle Taiga of all people...
They know they don't stand a chance, but they're not backing down.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (To see if they can actually surpass RAD WEEKEND someday...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know your head's a mess right now because you don't understand what's going on. So, just don't think.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Because all I know is how to sing!!!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Everything I was feeling just now went away a little the second I started singing.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can focus more than usual. I can hear everyone's voices so clearly. It's like when we performed at Crawl Green.)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Shiraishi... She was so distraught a second ago, but she's singing like she normally does... No, maybe even better...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(And we need to keep up.
We can't let her resolve go to waste!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Just hearing An singing next to me puts me at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I feel like we can do anything right now.
I can sing better... I know I can!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(...!
The way Shiraishi's singing! She's trying to lift us back up...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Don't think! Sing with instinct! With intuition! No plan is gonna help us beat Uncle Taiga. It doesn't matter how much we try to think...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So, just sing! Throw absolutely everything you have at him! Keep fighting! Don't give him an inch!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Everything I have...
Everything I've learned, seen, experienced...!!!)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Haha. It's always a pleasure to teach you since you're such a quick learner, An. Now, fist bump!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hi there!
Having another morning practice, An?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
An, one more time!
I can't leave after that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I'll freeze up if I do...
I have to forget about her...! About Aunt Nagi...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to get her out of my head...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is bad! Shiraishi's voice is starting to shake...!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Is that really all you got, An?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Is this all Nagi gave you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(She gave me music...
She's why I'm singing at all!!!)

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: W-Was that An's voice just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Let's do this! We gotta see this through until the end...!!)

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
That was awesome!
Way to go, Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Right at the end they pulled off their best performance ever!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Taiga was also completely off the hook earlier...! But maybe! Just maybe!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too...
Also, my head's spinning from concentrating so hard...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (So, this is what you were talking about, Nagi. The “next generation” or whatever...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Credit where credit's due...
That wasn't bad.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Will you stop leering at me like that? Oh, you've lost your voice...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Honestly, you probably sounded better than I did that night.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which is why it's time for you all to see.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm going to show you how RADder and our dreams ended that night.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (I'll sing a RADder song. Only today.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (I'll show these kids what we were hoping to do. That's what you guys want me to do, right?)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This isn't like me at all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Just listening to him is making all this fire well up inside of me...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hm? What's wrong...?
You all look totally dumbfounded.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The RAD WEEKEND you've all placed on a pedestal is just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Hey, let's get outta here...
I can't watch them take much more of this...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah...
A part of me was hoping that they'd put up a better fight...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: But no one's going to top that...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Now do you understand?
This is what you're all up against.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: If you wanna keep trying to surpass us, be my guest.
